quantification_note: Explicitly undeclared 2026-09-03: only the basis conversion is recorded (8.7 mg furosine / 100 g protein); no method sentence on disk (furosine is conventionally ion-pair HPLC-UV, not asserted). The envelope keeps the core's absolute-concentration convention for this row and says so.

metadata.notes: Furosine crossover anchor encoded as a representative mild-extrusion point. Use together with the safety payload and predictor directionality tests to enforce the post-150 C decline.

unit_correction_note.what_changed: conc_ppb held 87.0, which is neither the source anchor nor a ppb value: the anchor is 8.7 mg furosine per 100 g protein (Ramirez-Jimenez 2000 mild-extrusion peak at 140 C, stored in data/lit/safety_reference_payloads.json). Converted on a DECLARED 20 g protein / 100 g food basis (the mid-point of the commercial PBMA/extrudate range, 15-25%): 8.7 mg/100 g protein x 0.20 = 1.74 mg/100 g food = 17.4 mg/kg = 17400 ppb. The conversion lives in src.safety.mg_per_100g_protein_to_ppb and FUROSINE_ANCHOR_PROTEIN_FRACTION so it is defined exactly once.
unit_correction_note.expected_miss: This benchmark is now EXPECTED TO FAIL. src.safety.predict_furosine returns ppb and predicts 86.5 ppb at these conditions against 17400 ppb: ratio 201x, i.e. 2.30 log10 units low, against a 2.0x / 0.3 dex contract.
unit_correction_note.policy: Tolerances are deliberately UNCHANGED. The pre-correction pass was an artifact of a mg-per-100g-protein number sitting in a ppb field. The protein basis is the only defensible free parameter here and it is declared, not tuned: even at 100% protein the anchor would be 87000 ppb and the predictor would still be ~1000x low.

citation_audit_note.basis: source_doi 10.1021/jf9907687 verified against CrossRef: Ramirez-Jimenez, Guerra-Hernandez & Garcia-Villanova (2000), 'Browning Indicators in Bread', J. Agric. Food Chem. 48:4176. The DOI and the author/year label are correct. Caveat: the underlying study is TOASTED BREAD, not a legume extrudate; the intake registry row for this benchmark carries matrix_family='mild_legume_extrudate', which overstates the transfer. No numeric value or routing field was changed.
